messages:
sara (Docs): Hey folks — I have 2 small docs PRs that need reviewer assignment and a merge window: 1) migration guide for the new routing policy (PR #4212) and 2) updated Python SDK snippet + snippet tests (PR #4218). Can we pair reviewers?
kevin (Eng): I can pick up the SDK snippet (PR #4218). I have a 9am PT sync but can review before 10am PT.
omar (DevEx): I can take the migration guide (PR #4212). Quick question — does the guide reference the `smart-routing` flag that landed yesterday? If so I should test examples against the new flag.
ci-bot: docs-preview / PR 4218 — failed linkcheck: broken link https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/nginx-config (exit code 1)
liz (Docs): I’ll triage the linkcheck failure. Looks like an old internal link in the SDK snippet README. Small replace to https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/nginx should fix.
kevin (Eng): thx @liz — once that link is patched I’ll re-run the snippet tests locally (`pytest tests/snippets/test_python_snippet.py -k sdk_example`).
omar (DevEx): @sara I checked PR #4212 — it mentions `smart-routing` but only in the conceptual section. I can run a quick end-to-end example against staging to confirm CLI flags. Will do that after lunch.
chris (SDK): I have one small nit in PR #4218 (inline param name). If kevin wants to run the tests and I give an approve, can someone merge once CI is green? :thumbsup:
sara (Docs): Plan: assign PR #4218 -> kevin (SDK review) + chris (nits); PR #4212 -> omar (migration guide). @liz please push the link fix patch to #4218. If CI passes, target merge during the docs merge window tomorrow 11:00am PT. Are we good?
liz (Docs): Pushed fix in a tiny commit, CI retriggered.
ci-bot: docs-preview / PR 4218 — queued; tests running (snippet tests, linkcheck).
kevin (Eng): Running tests now — snippet tests pass locally, linkcheck should be fixed. I’ll approve once CI shows green.
ci-bot: docs-preview / PR 4218 — success ✅ (linkcheck + snippet tests).
kevin (Eng): Approved.
chris (SDK): Approve — nit addressed.
sara (Docs): Great — I’ll merge #4218 at 11:00am PT tomorrow during the merge window. Omar: ping me when your staging run for #4212 is done and we’ll schedule canary. Also note folks — reviewer rotation is thin this week, if you can pick up 1 docs review that helps coverage.
omar (DevEx): Staging run complete, examples verified against `smart-routing` flag. Left a tiny clarifying note. Ready for final review.
sara (Docs): Thanks — final check then canary merge scheduled for 11:30am PT (to give time for any last-minute rollbacks). If anything blocks, flag here. :party-parrot:
